The project uses third-party packages at installation time. This directory records their upstream license families for convenience; consult the installed package metadata and upstream repositories for the authoritative terms.

- openpyxl: MIT
- python-docx: MIT
- pandas: BSD-3-Clause
- pypdf: BSD-3-Clause
- pdfplumber: MIT
- reportlab: BSD-style
- matplotlib: Matplotlib License (BSD-compatible)
- weasyprint: BSD-3-Clause
- docx (npm): MIT
- pptxgenjs: MIT

Optional system applications such as LibreOffice, Pandoc, Poppler, and qpdf retain their own licenses and are not bundled by this repository.
